text:
Jo: Quick brain-dump after reviewing the routing editor prototype. Main things: preview snapshot playback, how we highlight the winning rule, and clearer conflict copy. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi789/routing-proto
Ravi: Love the snapshot playback idea. Two requests: show a tiny timestamp on each frame and allow scrubbing with left/right arrow. Also low-priority: animated highlight on match for 120ms then fade to subtle state.
Maya: Accessibility: announce matches with aria-live polite. When multiple rules match in a trace, read the dominant match first and summarize others as "also considered".
Priya: Copy nudge: replace 'Rule suppressed' with 'Overridden by higher-priority rule' — clearer for support tickets. But we should keep a one-line badge: 'Overridden'.
Ravi: UX suggestion: add a 'heatmap' strip on the left of the rule list showing historical match frequency (tiny bars). Hover shows percentage. Helps reorder decisions.
Maya: Keyboard + screen reader note: heatmap must be decorative by default (aria-hidden) but available via a 'show analytics' toggle that exposes a table view for keyboard nav.
Jo: Preview trace UI: show matched rule as a pulsing outline, and include a mini diff when a rule changes output ("+ header added"). Use a chevron to expand diff lines.
Priya: For conflicts, two levels: inline badge short text and an expandable detail panel with timeline and explanation. Short badge: 'Overridden by Rule X'. Detail: 'Rule A ran earlier in priority order and prevented Rule B from executing because it matched the same request path.'
Ravi: Backend constraint: diffs are expensive for every preview. Let's lazy compute diffs on expand and cache for 15 minutes. Also debounce preview playback events 220ms.
Maya: design-lint-bot: accessibility quick scan: pulse animation baseline 0.12s high-contrast fails for motion-sensitive users. Recommend honoring prefers-reduced-motion and use 0.08s fallback for users who allow motion. Also heatmap color ramp fails 2.9:1 for low values.
Jo: Good call. We'll add prefers-reduced-motion support, tweak colors, and add a legend for the heatmap.
Priya: Small copy tweak request: change modal CTA from 'Resolve' to 'Choose action' and the default action should be 'Edit rule' rather than 'Drop' to prevent accidental deletes.
Ravi: I'll wire optimistic UI for reorders, include an undo snackbar with the server error message if it fails. Also will expose a feature flag to disable heatmap for lower tiers.
Maya: I'll produce two mock variants: compact list with heatmap off, and analytics-enabled layout with table view. Also produce keyboard flow doc for scrubbing and diff expansion.
Jo: TL;DR checklist: snapshot scrubber + keyboard arrows, pulse highlight (reduced-motion aware), short vs verbose conflict copy, lazy diffs, heatmap with legend + aria-hidden toggle, optimistic reorder + undo, change CTA to 'Choose action'. Sync Friday 3pm to review mocks. Thanks all!
